on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

out2=grid_after(users[2],'Demo pair 2 output (10x10):')

def transform(grid):
    a=np.array(grid); h,w=a.shape
    bg=int(np.bincount(a.ravel(),minlength=10).argmax())
    labs,n=label(a==bg) # 4-connected
    res=a.copy()
    border_ids=set(labs[0,:])|set(labs[-1,:])|set(labs[:,0])|set(labs[:,-1])
    for k in range(1,n+1):
        if k in border_ids: continue
        hole=(labs==k)
        # all non-background cells 8-adjacent to the hole
        near=np.zeros_like(hole)
        rr,cc=np.where(hole)
        for r,c in zip(rr,cc):
            near[max(0,r-1):min(h,r+2),max(0,c-1):min(w,c+2)]=True
        boundary=near & (a!=bg)
        br,bc=np.where(boundary)
        r0,r1,c0,c1=br.min(),br.max(),bc.min(),bc.max()
        sub=a[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]
        vals=sub[(sub!=bg)&~boundary[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]]
        # Better: count non-line marker colors, regardless of position
        linecolors=set(a[boundary].tolist())
        vals=sub[(sub!=bg)&~np.isin(sub,list(linecolors))]
        if len(vals):
            counts=np.bincount(vals,minlength=10)
            target=int(counts.argmax())
            res[boundary]=target
    return res.tolist()
for i,o in [(inp,out),(inp2,out2)]:
    pred=transform(i)
    print(pred==o)
    if pred!=o:
        print(np.argwhere(np.array(pred)!=np.array(o)))
        print(Counter(zip(np.array(pred)[np.array(pred)!=np.array(o)],np.array(o)[np.array(pred)!=np.array(o)])))

print('changes',Counter(zip(T[T!=P],P[T!=P])))
print(np.argwhere(T!=P).tolist())

def transform(grid):
    a=np.array(grid); counts=np.bincount(a.ravel(),minlength=10)
    bg=int(counts.argmax()); line=int(np.argsort(counts)[-2])
    labs,n=label(a!=line)
    res=a.copy(); h,w=a.shape
    for k in range(1,n+1):
        region=labs==k
        vals=a[region]
        markers=vals[(vals!=bg)&(vals!=line)]
        if not len(markers): continue
        target=int(np.bincount(markers,minlength=10).argmax())
        near=np.zeros_like(region); rr,cc=np.where(region)
        for r,c in zip(rr,cc):
            near[max(0,r-1):min(h,r+2),max(0,c-1):min(w,c+2)]=True
        boundary=near&(a==line)
        res[boundary]=target
    return res.tolist()
for i,o in [(inp,out),(inp2,out2)]:
    pred=transform(i); print(pred==o)
    if pred!=o:
        neq=np.array(pred)!=np.array(o); print(np.argwhere(neq)); print(Counter(zip(np.array(pred)[neq],np.array(o)[neq])))
P=np.array(transform(test)); print('changes',Counter(zip(T[T!=P],P[T!=P]))); print(np.argwhere(T!=P).tolist())
